newsitem.title: USA: Circus Circus says Q4 hurt by construction.
newsitem.headline: Circus Circus says Q4 hurt by construction.

text.p: Circus Circus Entertprise Inc on Thursday said its fourth quarter earnings were hurt by construction at two of its major hotel and casino operations in Las Vegas, the Luxor and Circus Circus-Las Vegas.

The company reported earnings for its fiscal fourth quarter, ended January 31, of $0.16 a share on total revenue of $304.6 million versus $0.35 a share on revenue of $323.6 million one year ago. Analysts' consensus forecast was $0.18 a share in the fourth quarter, according to investment research company, First Call.
Operating cash flow at Luxor was $12.6 million versus $20.3 million last year, while cash flow at Circus Circus Las Vegas fell to $8.5 million from $13.7 million.
In a statement, Circus Circus noted construction continues at the two operations in the current quarter.

Foul weather in and around Reno, Nevada caused results to fall at Circus Circus-Reno and the Silver Legacy. Those two properties produced $3.0 million in cash flow versus $6.6 million in fiscal 1996's fourth quarter.
On a positive note, Circus said results at its 50-percent owned Monte Carlo casino continued to exceed expectations with cash flow of $23.9 million. The hotel opened last summer.
